meta.primary_weight: Unweighted average of 56 NTA country-team labor-income profiles, normalized to a 30-49 mean of 1.

metrics.S: sum_a w(a) * P(a) / sum P(a), with w = NTA average labor income. Units: effective prime-age labor-income equivalents per person.
metrics.esr: sum_a yl(a) P(a) / sum_a c(a) P(a), same NTA average profiles. Levels are profile-relative (yl and c are each normalized to their own 30-49 mean); ranks and changes are not.
